comment: OPTIONAL overrides for the schedule sync (REQ-087). The gym's Google Calendar is the source of truth and every event publishes on its own: a title nobody has seen before is classified from its own words, so this file being empty is a correct and expected configuration. Add an entry only to state a classification by hand, for example when a class name does not say which program it belongs to, or when you want a tidier name on the site than the one in the calendar. Match is case-insensitive and treats ASCII hyphens and U+2011 as the same character. Keys: match (the calendar event title; defaults to display), display (what the site prints), category (adults, kids, muaythai or wrestling; picks the cell colour, the program filter and the per-program feed), discipline, audience, level. Only the keys you set are applied, the rest stay inferred. Defaults that are never printed as a badge: audience Adults, level All levels.
